examShortTricks: Trick 1: Hydrolysis one-liner: aqueous Na2CO3 is alkaline (CO3²− + H2O ⇌ HCO3− + OH−) — explains why it cleans grease.
Trick 2: With CO2: Na2CO3 + CO2 + H2O → 2NaHCO3 (sodium bicarbonate); with SO2: Na2SO3 + CO2 + H2O — same pattern, swap the acid gas.
Trick 3: Precipitation: CaCl2 + Na2CO3 → CaCO3↓ (white) + 2NaCl; Mg2+ similarly — hard-water softening application.
Trick 4: Heating test: 2NaHCO3 → Na2CO3 + H2O + CO2 — used to distinguish the two salts.
